info.title: Web Screenshot Service API
info.description: An API that uses a headless Chrome instance to take screenshots of web pages. The behavior of the screenshot capture can be customized via URL query parameters.

get.description: Renders a web page from a URL or raw HTML source in a headless browser and returns a screenshot. Users must provide either a 'url' or an 'html' query parameter.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The full URL of the web page to capture. Required if 'html' parameter is not provided.

parameters.name: html
parameters.description: The raw HTML source code to render and capture. Required if 'url' parameter is not provided.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: The quality of the image, from 1 to 100. If set to a value less than 100, the output format will be JPEG. Otherwise, it will be PNG.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the browser viewport in pixels.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the browser viewport in pixels.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Determines the area of the page to capture. 'viewport' captures the visible part of the page, while 'content' captures the full scrollable page.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: An optional event name or selector to wait for before taking the screenshot, allowing for dynamic content to load.

400.description: Bad Request. An invalid value was provided for one of the query parameters, or neither 'url' nor 'html' was provided.

500.description: Internal Server Error. The screenshot capture process failed on the server.
